song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Pervading every state of moving and unmoving, consciousness itself is one — without end or beginning.
Bhairava, Lord, refuge of the helpless — with a mind become Yours, in my heart, I bow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayam ekam anantam anādim bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande

verses.craft: Full naming then bow-by-becoming (absorption not offering); nirukta performed-not-stated; carācara/anādi opens kept open.
verses.rejected: (a) glossing the name → killed: performed, never stated. (b) resolving particularity/negation scope → killed by UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'carācarabhāvaviśeṣa' means particular states or the particularity of states is unresolved.", "Whether 'anādi' negates temporal beginning only or all limitation is unresolved.", 'The nirukta is performed, not stated; the verse does not gloss its own name.']) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
